opportunities.name: jetBlue flight search with sort/filter
opportunities.description: Search jetBlue for flights from {origin} to {destination} as {trip_type} on {depart_date}[–{return_date}], optionally paying in points, then sort results by lowest price.
steps: Open jetblue.com, Flights tab
Set trip type (Roundtrip/One-way) if needed
Type origin in From and pick airport/city area from dropdown
Type destination in To and pick airport
Pick depart date (and return date) in calendar
Optionally tick 'Use TrueBlue points'
Click Search flights; confirm 'Continue to flight results' dialog if shown
Optionally toggle Dollars/Points
Open Sort & Filter, choose price (low to high / Price by Core), Apply
Review cheapest flight / open Details

instances.values: JFK → Miami MIA, roundtrip Mar 27–Mar 31, switched to Points, sort Price by Core
New York City area (NYC) → Toronto YYZ, one-way Apr 29, sort Price low to high, opened details
NYC → Aruba AUA, roundtrip May 1–May 5, Use TrueBlue points, sort Price low to high

opportunities.name: Avis Budget Group careers job search by filters
opportunities.description: From the Budget site footer, open Careers, then filter Avis Budget Group openings by {country}, {team} and {time_type} and search.
steps: On budget.com scroll to footer and click Company Info > Careers
Click 'Openings'
Expand Country filter and select country
Expand Team filter and select team
Expand Time Type filter and select time type
Click 'Search by job title or keyword'
Optionally open a job posting and click Apply Now

instances.values: Country=United States, Team=Finance, Time Type=Full time; opened Accounts Payable Associate, Apply Now
Country=United States, Team=Finance, Time Type=Full time; searched

opportunities.name: United.com car rental search
opportunities.description: On united.com Book > Car, search rental cars at {pickup_location} from {pickup_date} to {dropoff_date} with given pickup/dropoff times and miles option.
steps: Open united.com, Book tab, click CAR
Optionally toggle 'Book with miles'
Type pickup location and choose suggestion
Open Rental dates calendar, pick pickup date then drop-off date
Set pickup time and drop-off time dropdowns
Click Find cars

instances.values: Caldwell (Ohio), Apr 8–Apr 13, pickup 8:00 a.m., drop-off 12:00 p.m., book with miles checked
Brooklyn - Central (New York), Apr 9–Apr 15, 10:00 a.m./10:00 a.m., miles unchecked

opportunities.name: Retail product search with price/attribute filter and add to cart
opportunities.description: Search a retail site for {query}, apply a price limit or attribute filter, pick a product and add it to the cart or compare prices.
steps: Type product query into site search and pick suggestion
Apply price max (and/or attribute filter such as noise cancellation / free delivery)
Sort or scan results
Open/select product
Click Add to Cart (or compare seller prices)

instances.values: Menards: 'swivel vacuum', max price 150, add Shepherd swivel caster wheel to cart
Google Shopping: 'Granitestone sandwich maker', compare prices, Free delivery, sort by total price

opportunities.name: NPS Find a Park by activity/topic
opportunities.description: On nps.gov Find a Park, filter parks by {activity} or {topic} and run the search.
steps: From nps.gov home click 'Find a Park' / 'See All Parks'
Open the By Activity or By Topic dropdown
Tick the desired activity/topic
Click Search and browse results

instances.values: By Topic = Industry, Laborer and Worker

opportunities.name: MTA bridge & tunnel toll rates by vehicle
opportunities.description: On new.mta.info, go to Bridges & Tunnels tolls and open the toll rates page for {vehicle_type}.
steps: Open new.mta.info
Navigate to Bridges & Tunnels tolls (Menu > Agencies > Bridges & Tunnels, or Fares & Tolls > Bridges and Tunnels tolls)
Click Tolls by vehicle / Toll Rates
Click the vehicle type card
Read toll rates
